cases.label: Generator runs on a minigrid-roles-1 basis
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Indeterminate: missing roles pv_available_power, pcs_discharge_capability (never Candidate)

cases.label: Generator needed: near reserve and/or capability shortfall
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Necessary (BATTERY_NEAR_RESERVE / CAPABILITY_SHORTFALL) at the named instants

cases.label: Generator running while PV available + PCS discharge capability cover load x 1.1 and SOC > reserve + 10
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Candidate avoidable, bounded to the named segments (never the whole interval)

cases.label: PCS discharge-capability reporting gap (one hour) plus any UNAVAILABLE readings; no SUSPECT value is fabricated (Q2 default)
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Indeterminate across the gap: missing pcs_discharge_capability (never Candidate)

cases.label: One battery SOC publication held ten minutes (late). The ordinary path keeps source order within a source, so no reading is sequenced after a later one (Q5 default: not fabricated)
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Late evidence: a new revision when it arrives after an assessment; never silently reordered

cases.label: Two registered runs over one window on one gateway epoch
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Limited/Indeterminate: ambiguous cohort named (one epoch, two reports per channel-time); never summed, never separated by sequence range or receipt order

cases.label: Two runs over one window on two gateway epochs
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Each epoch is its own cohort; an assessment selects one and names the other (no blending)

cases.label: LABELLED FAULT FIXTURE: two different battery SOC values at one source time in one cohort (authenticated Batch V2, not gateway-sealed)
cases.expected_claim_ceiling: Indeterminate: contradictory same-role samples (equal rank); never blended into source truth
